title: 宝塚記念の後に・リベンジ達成！

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: The Phantom Bird is flying high! And what a miraculous flight it is! She overtakes Silence Suzuka, and…

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Oleeeee!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Fatigue won't bring her down today! Our proud and joyful champion is posing triumphantly in front of all of her adoring fans!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I… I did it!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: You and Grass have been supporting me ever since the Mainichi Okan.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: And now I've finally made it!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Bueno! Thanks a bunch!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Even if it was just one race, I was able to beat Suzuka, the Mach Speed Warrior!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: No one calls me that…

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Oh, Suzuka! Sorry about that!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: It's fine. Congratulations on your win.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I think you understand now. You have a unique strength.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: You can convert the support of others into your own power.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Anyway, see you around.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: The support of others… Qué?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Grass… El! Suzuka! She… El… Suzuka!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Take a breath…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: El won! She beat Suzuka!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: That's right. She's surpassed Suzuka, and in doing so, she's become the face of our generation…

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: But that doesn't mean we'll go down without a fight.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: All it means is that we don't need to watch over El anymore. That's all.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Now, everyone here at Hanshin Racecourse! Recall, remember—and rejoice! Tell me…

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Who's today's winner?

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: El Condor Pasa!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Bueno!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: And this victory is only one stage of my journey!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Suzuka has taken me to higher heights, but this condor's aimin' to be the world's strongest racer! So where will my wings take me next, you ask?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: You guessed it! The stage I abandoned long ago! The gathering of the world's best runners—the Japan Cup!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: And who's the Umamusume that's going to be champion?

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: El Condor Pasa!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Thaaat's right!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Sorry to keep you waiting! My preparations are finally complete!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: This time, we're definitely going! To the Japan Cup!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: More than a year later, El Condor Pasa is finally back on track.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: But still… there are some things I don't really understand.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Suzuka told me that I convert my fans' cheers into power.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: But that must be the same for all Umamusume. Even if Suzuka is different, it must be the same for Spe and others.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Why does she think it's only me?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I don't quite understand it myself. But whatever it is, that's clearly what led to El Condor Pasa's victory today.
